title: In sentences: 40 to 100 — сорока, пятидесяти, ста…

items.text: «Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.» For 40, 90 and 100: «Note that there are only two forms:

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 71, p. 33. · Every form on this page is the OpenCorpora dictionary's own (CC BY-SA 4.0), put together by the rules quoted above.

Real sentences: from the library's public-domain books (author and title above each), and from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), shown with their translation. The numeral is blanked; type it in the form the sentence needs. ё and е are both accepted.

exercises.q: Около ___ (80, gen.) миллионов бактерий передаются во время десятисекундного поцелуя.
exercises.prompt: *About 80 million bacteria are transferred during a 10 second kiss.*
exercises.why: **восемьдесят → восьмидесяти** (gen.: около + genitive). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

whys.forty: «Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.» For 40, 90 and 100: «Note that there are only two forms: 1) N. & A. сорок, девяносто, сто; 2) In all other cases — сорока, девяноста, ста.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 71, p. 33.
